title: Reese Olson (RC) 2024 Topps Series 1 Rookie Card #308 Base • Detroit Tigers
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This Reese Olson 2024 Topps baseball card features the rookie player in his Detroit Tigers uniform with the card number 308. The card is made of 20 Pt. card stock material and belongs to the Tiger parallel/variety. It is an original card from the Topps manufacturer and is part of the 2024 Topps set. 

The card is a standard size sports trading card in English language with the features of a base set and rookie player. The card is not autographed and is not a vintage or licensed reprint. This card celebrates Olson's participation in the MLB World Series in 2024.
